entry.text: Two-forty-eight. Two people, one algorithm, and a loaf of bread.

hotspots.label: Brad (sourdough starter)
examine: Brad. Bubbling. The only thing in this flat allowed to ferment unsupervised.
Brad has doubled since Tuesday. Emotionally, so have I.

hotspots.label: shelf
hotspots.examine: Cookbooks from when recipes were instructions, not subscriptions.

hotspots.label: bed
hotspots.examine: Made. Technically. The duvet has achieved a truce.

hotspots.label: lamp
hotspots.examine: Warm. Dumb. Loyal. The last appliance I'd defend in court.

hotspots.label: window
hotspots.examine: Rain. Somewhere out there, Theo is typing. And retyping. And being retyped.

hotspots.label: desk
hotspots.examine: A pen. Actual paper. My grandmother's cryptography.

do.say: I write six words by hand. My handwriting has a nerve tremor and zero content moderation.
The note is written. The pen rests. Legend.

hotspots.label: phone
hotspots.examine: Kismet has us at 61% chemistry. It docks points for sincerity.

start.text: Theo: so how's Brad doing 😄 — ⚠ KISMET: Theo's message held 0.3s for review. Cleared! Reminder: keep it wholesome, you two! 💜

choices.t: Type: Brad doubled! I think he likes you.
Type: I really like you, Theo.

blocked1.text: ⚠ KISMET: BLOCKED — 'he likes you' anthropomorphizes a yeast colony (attachment risk). Suggested wording: 'The bread project proceeds.'

choices.t: Send the suggestion. Die inside slightly.
Type: it's BREAD, you absolute firewall.

blocked2.text: ⚠ KISMET: BLOCKED — 'really like' exceeds your Chemistry Score (61%). Unlock 'like' at 70%. Suggested: 'You are adequate, Theo.'

choices.t: Put the phone down (look around the room)

blocked3.text: ⚠ KISMET: BLOCKED — hostility toward moderation (that's me!). One more strike and this conversation gets a Wellness Pause. 💜

choices.t: Put the phone down (look around the room)

adequate.text: Theo: did… did Kismet write that — ⚠ KISMET: Theo's message held for review: meta-commentary. Suggested reply for Theo: 'Haha!' — Theo: Haha!

choices.t: He knows. I know. It knows we know.

beige.text: Delivered! Theo: the bread project proceeds 👍 — KISMET: Chemistry +0.1! See how nice neutral feels?

choices.t: This is the beigest flirting in human history.

paper.text: ⚠ KISMET: IMAGE SCAN… paper detected. No text layer found. No policy exists for… whatever this is. Delivering unmoderated (logging incident). — Theo: is that PAPER?? hold on — Theo: [photo: a handwritten note] 'coffee. tomorrow. no chaperone.'

choices.t: Look at the phone. Look at Brad. Smile.

together.text: Theo: settings → account → down here, same screen as you — KISMET: WAIT. Terminating deletes 847 beautifully moderated conversations and your Chemistry Score (61%)! Couples who leave Kismet have UNVERIFIED outcomes!!

end.line: 02:48. Two terminations, one second apart. Outcome: unverified. Unverified is where everything good lives.
